kshanmugam@wc.com 

BY MESSENGER AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

July 2, 2018 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC  20543 

Re:  Helsinn Healthcare S.A. v. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., No. 17-1229 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  On behalf of both parties, I 
write to request extensions of time on the merits briefs and joint appendix in this case, as 
follows: 

Brief of petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief of respondents: 

August 23, 2018 
October 9, 2018 

Both  parties  have  agreed  to  the  foregoing  schedule,  which  would  enable  this  case  to  be 
heard during the Court’s December 2018 sitting.  If you need any additional information 
from us, please do not hesitate to let me know. 

Yours sincerely, 

/s/ 

Kannon K. Shanmugam 

cc:  William M. Jay, Esq. (counsel for petitioner)
